data.title: Kimly’s Scale, Cash Resources and Halal Expansion Support a Buy Despite Near-Term Earnings Pressure
data.description:
Zheng Feng Chee, an analyst from DBS, maintained the Buy rating on Kimly Ltd.. The associated price target is S$0.41.

Zheng Feng Chee gave his rating based on several factors, including Kimly’s scale, integrated operations and central kitchens, which support competitive pricing. Its net cash of about SGD63mn provides flexibility to pursue acquisitions or joint ventures as weaker operators come under pressure. Expansion into Halal coffee shops through Kedai Kopi and Tenderfresh adds exposure to a sizeable, underpenetrated market.
Although near-term earnings are constrained by wage inflation, softer industry conditions and limited revenue growth, the analyst expects the decline to moderate rather than repeat FY26’s sharp drop. He sees industry stress creating consolidation opportunities over the next 12-18 months, with Kimly positioned to use its balance sheet and listed status to fund expansion. The Buy call is further supported by the SGD0.41 target price, protected dividend and ongoing share buybacks, which may cushion downside while acquisitions provide longer-term upside.
